question: Can original organiser reports establish a named completed film receiving Dhwani/BPFTIO production assistance?

access_advance.method: Ordinary direct download from the original organiser URLs, followed by local page rendering and individual visual inspection.
access_advance.prior_limit: The earlier cycle could not read the 2023–24 original or inspect the 2024–25 annexures. Those historical access failures remain recorded; this cycle supersedes the access limitation only.
access_advance.claims: Retrieval and page coverage are verified. They do not establish a supported production, a payment or an audience outcome.

coverage.17: Reproduced press collage including Dhwani festival inauguration
coverage.13–14: Kallola films and school groups; anniversary account begins

limits: Every page was visually inspected for the bounded film-support question; this is not a line-by-line transcription or financial audit.
Small overlapping press clippings are not fully legible. The readable Dhwani clipping concerns the festival, not a production-support recipient.
The introductory anniversary sequence and detailed event account differ in date ordering. Omit a precise Kallola day in any proposed addition.
Romanized titles and institutional names below reproduce report wording. No original film title card, spoken language, individual child identity or production-year claim is verified.
Original has 32 pages; earlier web extraction reported 30. This discrepancy alone is not proof of revision.
Project SHRUTI school screenings concern health, not cinema.
A projector asset purchase is not a named film-support receipt. No financial audit or payment transcription claimed.

sources.access: All four pages extracted text read, without visual inspection in this step.
sources.finding: The support offer remains conditional on the selected script's writer proceeding; screening depends on readiness.

outcome.finding: Neither inspected annual report establishes a named completed film linked to delivery of Dhwani/BPFTIO production support. This leaves the question open; it does not show that support was not delivered.
outcome.next_evidence: A selected-script announcement plus finished-film credit, or an organiser/recipient record explicitly linking a named completed film to the assistance.
outcome.repeat_search_gate: Do not repeat generic film-title, institute or rules searches without a new original record.

adjacent_finding.candidate_text: Children can enter cinema as makers as well as viewers. In 2016, Kallola-Junior included Aji Thu Ekathi, made by students of St Xavier's High School, Khandagiri. Aaina's later annual report also names Nagabali Ra Abhiman, made by students of Pitamahal Ashram School. These are concrete examples of children making room for their own stories.

adjacent_finding.useful_next_step: The compact attributed example is available for editorial integration. Close reading awaits an identifiable organiser/school film release; no repeat generic title searches.

corroboration.consequence: The later annual-report mention is not evidence of a new 2024 production. Retrospective or repeat screening is possible, but not independently established; no premiere/production-year claim.
